name: CoinGecko API
summary: Cryptocurrency market data (prices, market caps, volumes, OHLCV, onchain DEX pools and tokens) over a REST API, hosted MCP servers, an SDK and an agent SKILL package. Three ways in for an agent, all documented by the vendor: a keyless public tier with no sign-up at a low IP-shared rate limit, keyed plans (a free Demo key and paid tiers) and an experimental x402 pay-per-use path at $0.01 USDC per request with no key or account at all.

payments.notes: Measured 2026-09-11 and 2026-09-19, no payment made: the x402 path answers 402 (x402Version 2, scheme exact, 10000 units of USDC, $0.01, Base or Solana). Keyed plans are subscriptions paid by card ('Pay with Visa, Mastercard, AMEX, JCB') or crypto; pricing page read on screen 2026-09-19.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-10, 09-18 and 09-19: keyless REST simple/price 200; keyless MCP initialize 200, tools/list 200 with two tools (execute runs JavaScript against the API; search_docs); no discovery document at either well-known URI; unpaid x402 GET 402 ($0.01 USDC, Base or Solana); Pro host 401.

jobs.summary: Vendor's llms.txt: real-time and historical cryptocurrency data (prices, OHLCV, market cap, volume, NFT and onchain DeFi data) for coins, tokens, pools and exchanges via REST API, WebSocket and Webhooks, with an SDK and hosted MCP servers. Vendor's claim; freshness and coverage not measured.
